purpose: Freeze the existing human-reviewed Victorian evidence before comparing any additional pretrained model or beginning any fine-tuning.
rules: Do not change a locked artifact in place. Create a new manifest revision with the reason, reviewer, and date.
Do not tune a model threshold, select a checkpoint, or choose an architecture using a pilot case and then report that same case as final performance.
Unmatched predictions remain review items unless the case has a complete independent negative reference set.
A new method must record its model identifier, source, inference settings, image dates, and code commit before comparison.

cases.scene_type: dense CBD with tall buildings and heavy shadow
supported_measurements: candidate recall against seven human-confirmed visible reference changes
candidate intersections with three rejected mapping-only reference changes
review workload, reported as candidate count and unmatched predictions
limitations: Reference shapes are City of Melbourne wall/base footprints, not pixel-perfect roof labels.
The reference set is incomplete outside its ten reviewed footprint differences, so unmatched predictions are not false positives.
This case cannot set a production threshold or certify outline quality.

cases.scene_type: new estate with small buildings, pools, gardens, driveways and cast shadows
supported_measurements: failure-mode accounting for shadows, missed buildings, fragmented outlines, pools, gardens and hardscape
manual site-level recall observations where the reviewer recorded known building totals
qualitative comparison of complete after-date roof outlines against partial change evidence
limitations: Existing labels describe candidates from prior methods and are not independent, complete building geometry ground truth.
Several site labels intentionally have unknown building totals.
This case must not be used as a sole numeric recall or precision score for a new method.

cases.scene_type: Docklands high-density waterfront / inner-city building with one map-suggested new building
supported_measurements: candidate recall against one human-confirmed visibly new building
qualitative alignment check between the official reference outline and the visible new building
limitations: One confirmed change is only an independent smoke test, not a model-selection score.
The human review records good reference-outline alignment, but has no independent manually digitised roof polygon, so it cannot measure roof IoU.
No explicit negative labels exist, so it cannot measure false-positive precision.

promotion_requirements: Add geographically independent Victorian cases for a shaded suburb, low-rise estate, industrial area and CBD.
For every promoted hold-out case, label full after-date roof geometry and each permanent change as new building, extension, demolition, pool, driveway, garden/soil, shadow or vehicle.
Record explicit negatives so false-positive precision can be measured.
Keep hold-out labels hidden from model and threshold selection until the comparison run is complete.
